label: D2 after choosing a2 and landing in S2 (common a2 transition), when value is high
explanation: Update-gate unit 0 never fires at D1 and fires almost only on trials where the agent chose a2 (99.9% of activation mass): 80% of mass at D2, 20% at GO. At D2 it fires mainly when a2 led to S2 (common transition, in_state==2, in_action==2) and the model value is high (>7.9). Activation is larger after runs of consecutive rewarded a2->S2 trials. Never fires when in_rew==1 (reward input at D1) or on a1 trials, and almost never on switch trials. It also fades over the episode: about 8% rate in trials 10-59, near zero after trial 70 (much of that is picked up by the value condition). Minor component: GO steps where a2 is chosen, often after an unrewarded trial (~20% of mass, not captured). The recorded predicate uses only observed inputs and the model value, no future variables. Dev: P 0.53, R 0.73, F1 0.62, mass recall 0.77. Adding the GO a2 clause raises mass recall to 0.96 but drops precision to 0.42, so it was not recorded.
